**Method:** `git show`/`git diff` + approved evidence dir only. Did **not** run the doctor, read credentials/keychain, invoke authentication, install, or modify anything.

## Criterion results

- **Privacy — PASS.** Config parsed only to derive a `hasOAuthAccount` boolean; contents never retained. `.credentials.json` inspected with `parseJson=false` → metadata only, never read. Env vars reduced to booleans + shell `file:line` + variable name (values never captured). `readError`/`parseError` surface as booleans, not caught-error text. Tests confirm a sentinel token never appears in probe/text/JSON output.
- **Read-only boundary — PASS.** Production scripts use only read syscalls (`lstat`/`realpath`/`statfs`/bounded `O_RDONLY|O_NONBLOCK` reads); no write/unlink/mkdir/chmod/chown/spawn/fetch. Repair/unknown flags rejected (exit 2) **before** `collect()` runs (asserted `collected===false`). Integration test deep-equals a before/after `snapshot()` of the synthetic home across every arg mode incl. `--fix`; an `EXECUTED` sentinel proves shell rc files and PATH `claude`/`security` binaries are never executed.
- **Meaningful tests — PASS.** 30+ behavioral assertions across pure core + tmp-home integration (distinct error states, severity ranking, redaction, non-execution, bounded 1 MB read, symlink/dangling-link handling). Synthetic homes only. Mutation evidence attached (35 diffs). Missing-module TDD reds correctly labeled as not behavior proof.
- **Safe metadata interpretation — PASS.** Findings are hedged observations; every fix is investigative ("Inspect/Check/Consult"), never destructive (asserted: no chown/chmod/unset/delete/remove/move/"log in again"). macOS keychain explicitly not inspected — manual-check finding emitted; asserted no `security *-generic-password` string and no false credentials-missing on darwin. Header + JSON state auth/session validity **not** verified → no false login claim.
- **Count-only PATH reporting — PASS.** `findInstalls` dedups realpaths then returns `{executable:true}` objects (paths discarded); core reads only `.length`. `redactHome` backstops.
- **CI routing & regressions — PASS.** `test:diagnostics` runs both new test files; `targeted-tests-overrides.json` routes both source files to it, and the main-owned selector (`origin/main:scripts/targeted-tests.mjs:34`) consumes that file — so CI honors the mapping. Independent P2 repair (mappings moved from branch-local baseline into the main-consumed override) is sound; `test:mcp-deps` preserved. typecheck clean, agentic gate passed, full build succeeded (dynamic-import warnings pre-existing and unrelated).

- `redactHome` degenerate only if `HOME=='/'` (unrealistic; falsy home guarded).

**Approved with zero blocking findings.** Reviewed SHA `8a014fb513c5c2439497f62b91c45c1b874118f9` against base `378fd6764792bcecac20e6382e294204a6185d5e`.
